summary: Write, test and explain complex SQL using PostgreSQL, CTEs, window functions and JSONB. Explore the five-day course and practical outline.
lede: Complex SQL querying combines relational data through staged logic, joins and analytical calculations. For data analysts, reporting specialists and application developers who already write SQL, the course practises decomposing queries, checking join cardinality and validating results, alongside window functions and reusable CTEs in PostgreSQL. Exercises also cover temporal boundaries and JSONB extraction, with guided, overview-level treatment of dialect portability and advanced query features.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already write SQL and need to handle multi-step analysis, edge cases and complex relationships in their daily work.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of SQL SELECT statements, joins, filtering and GROUP BY. No separate programming language is required. Bring a laptop with PostgreSQL and pgAdmin installed; supplied practice datasets support the hands-on labs.
